    // The quad a corner contributes to an ortho: its own edge midpoint, the
    // vertex the corner points at, the next edge's midpoint, and the centroid.
    OrthoFaceOfCorner(self: PolygonMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): Array<VertexIndex>
        => [self.EdgeMidVertex(corner),
            self.CornerDestination(corner),
            self.EdgeMidVertex(self.NextCorner(corner)),
            self.FaceCentroidVertex(corner)];
